description: Focused LLM review repair PRD for PR #46. Scope is restricted to the blocking CSV formula-injection findings appended to progress.txt for the new aggregation and object-set diff export surfaces.

userStories.title: Harden CSV exports against formula injection
userStories.asA: user downloading aggregation or object-set diff CSV exports
userStories.iWant: user-controlled CSV string cells to be forced to text when they look like spreadsheet formulas
userStories.soThat: opening exported CSV files in spreadsheet software does not execute formulas from group values, primary keys, field names, or object values

acceptanceCriteria.given: an aggregation bucket has string group keys or values beginning with =, +, -, @, tab, CR, or leading whitespace before those characters
acceptanceCriteria.when: the aggregation CSV is built or downloaded
acceptanceCriteria.then: those string cells are prefixed with an apostrophe before RFC4180 escaping, while numeric metric values remain unprefixed numbers

acceptanceCriteria.given: an object-set diff includes primary keys, field names, or object values beginning with =, +, -, @, tab, CR, or leading whitespace before those characters
acceptanceCriteria.when: the object-set diff CSV is built or downloaded
acceptanceCriteria.then: those string cells are prefixed with an apostrophe before RFC4180 escaping while section labels and existing row structure remain unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.given: hardened CSV cells also contain commas, quotes, CR, or LF
acceptanceCriteria.when: the CSV serializers emit the file contents
acceptanceCriteria.then: RFC4180 quoting remains correct and existing CSV export behavior is preserved

verification: Targeted Vitest regression for aggregation CSV formula-like group keys and values.
Targeted Vitest regression for object-set diff CSV formula-like primary keys, field names, and values.
Relevant web CSV export tests and TypeScript gate.
